title: The Locked Library
intro:
You wake up on a cold stone floor inside a locked library. Dusty light falls across a desk, a bookshelf, a painting and a small locked drawer. The only way out is a heavy door with a four-digit keypad.

Type what you want to do, for example: examine the bookshelf. You can also type inventory for your items, hint for a nudge, or restart in the game controls.

desk.description: A worn oak desk. A letter on it reads: 'The shelf speaks in the order of the rainbow.'

bookshelf.description: Most of the books are identical, but four stand out. They are arranged differently from the rest.

books.missing_message: You need to inspect the bookshelf before you can pick out individual books.
books.description: Each of the four books has a handwritten number inside its cover: 4, 7, 1, 2.

painting.description: A landscape painting. Its frame looks slightly loose, and there is a tiny keyhole on the side.

flag_appendix.panel_open: The hidden panel behind it now stands open.

panel.missing_message: There is no panel you know about.
panel.description: The hidden panel behind the painting holds a folded paper.
panel.empty_description: The hidden panel is empty now.

drawer.description_locked: A small drawer with a four-digit combination lock. It is locked.

door.description: A heavy door with a four-digit keypad. The door is shut tight.
door.description_open: The heavy door stands open, revealing a pale corridor beyond.

brass_key.label: brass key
brass_key.missing_message: You cannot reach any key. The drawer is locked.
brass_key.take_message: You take the brass key from the drawer.
brass_key.examine_message: A small brass key. It might fit a narrow lock.

paper.label: paper
paper.missing_message: There is no paper you can reach.
paper.take_message: You take the folded paper. It reads: 8305.

drawer.no_clue_message: You have not found any clue about the drawer code yet, so the drawer stays locked.
drawer.wrong_message: The drawer does not open. Wrong code.

door.no_clue_message: You have not found any clue about the door code yet, so the door stays locked.
door.wrong_message: The keypad flashes red. Wrong code.
door.success_message: The keypad beeps and the door swings open. You escape the library!

painting.success_message: The key turns in the frame's keyhole. A hidden panel swings open behind the painting.
